en.faq_desc: Everything overseas procurement directors and indie founders need to know about working with us.
en.faq_q1: What is your Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
en.faq_a1_p1: We provide a flexible two-tier MOQ structure:
en.faq_a1_li1: In-Stock Standard Blank Bottles: 1,000 to 3,000 pcs (ideal for brand launches & formulation testing).
en.faq_a1_li2: Custom Color Spray & Silk-Screen Printing: 3,000 to 5,000 pcs per artwork.
en.faq_a1_li3: Bespoke Private Moulds: 30,000+ pcs with mold development in 15-20 days.
en.faq_q2: How does your Free Sample Kit program work?
en.faq_a2: Stock bottle samples and closure assortments are 100% free of charge! You only cover the express courier fee ($25–$35 USD via DHL/FedEx with 3-5 day delivery from Guangzhou). 100% of this courier fee will be credited back as a discount on your first bulk order.
en.faq_q3: Can you ship DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) to the US or Europe?
en.faq_a3: Yes! Over 80% of our Western clients choose our DDP door-to-door service. We handle Chinese export customs, ocean or air freight, destination customs clearance, and local trucking directly to your designated facility or Amazon FBA warehouse. You don't have to worry about complex tariff codes or customs brokers.
en.faq_q4: How do you guarantee formula compatibility and zero leaking?
en.faq_a4: Our bottles are manufactured with USP Type III medical-grade high-flint soda lime glass or amber glass, which is chemically inert and lead-free (Prop 65 & EU 1223/2009 compliant). We conduct 30-minute -0.08 MPa negative pressure vacuum leak tests on every cap/bottle pairing before mass dispatch.
en.faq_q5: What are your production lead times?
en.faq_a5_1: • In-Stock Blank Glass: Dispatched in 48–72 hours.
en.faq_a5_2: • Custom Color & Silk-Screen Printing: 15–20 business days.
en.faq_a5_3: • Custom Tooling & Mould Development: 20–25 days for pre-production samples.

en.about_hero_title: Your Turnkey Packaging & Quality Guardian in China
en.about_hero_desc: Headquartered in Guangzhou—the global heartland of cosmetic manufacturing—Jingtai Packaging bridges the gap between massive Chinese glass manufacturing capacity and the exacting standards of Western prestige beauty brands.
en.about_dilemma_title: Why Single-Line Factories Fail Modern Beauty Brands
en.about_dilemma_p1: In traditional manufacturing, glass furnaces only mold empty bottles. They do not manufacture dispensing pumps, they do not produce real bamboo collars, and they do not print secondary rigid boxes. When overseas buyers attempt to manage 4 different factories in China, a 0.2mm thread mismatch results in leaking containers, thousands of ruined formulations, and catastrophic delivery delays.
en.about_dilemma_p2: Jingtai Packaging operates differently. We function as your integrated turnkey packaging engineering team. We manage the entire ecosystem: high-flint glass container, precision-matched closures, surface decoration, custom outer boxes, and independent pre-shipment laboratory testing.
en.about_gz_title: The Guangzhou Advantage: Speed, Agility & Selection
en.about_gz_desc: Guangzhou (Baiyun District) is home to over 4,000 cosmetic and packaging enterprises. Operating at the epicenter of this cluster gives our clients unbeatable advantages.
en.about_adv1_desc: While remote inland factories take weeks to prepare physical samples, we pull directly from Guangzhou’s massive component repositories and express courier via DHL from Baiyun Airport in 48 hours.
en.about_adv2_desc: Immediate access to Guangzhou Nansha Port and Shenzhen Yantian Port allows us to book fast-track sea lanes to Long Beach, Oakland, and Rotterdam, reducing ocean transit times by 7-10 days.
en.about_adv3_desc: The world's highest density of advanced coating, silk printing, and electroplating lines ensures immediate access to the latest finishing trends and rapid Pantone lab strike-offs.
en.about_qa_desc: Every production run is verified by our dedicated Guangzhou QC team using calibrated metrology and pressure testing.
en.about_qa1_desc: Checked for wall thickness uniformity, bubble inclusions, and bottom flatness.
en.about_qa2_desc: Go/No-Go calibrated thread gauge ensures smooth cap screwing with zero cross-threading.
en.about_qa3_desc: Bottles immersed in water chambers at -0.08 MPa for 30 minutes to verify hermetic seal.
en.about_qa4_desc: Silk-screened and hot-stamped logos tested with 3M adhesive peel to guarantee zero flaking.
en.about_qa5_desc: Drop-tested inside reinforced cell cartons from 1.2m onto concrete to verify packaging integrity.

zh.faq_q1: 你们的起订量 (MOQ) 是多少？
zh.faq_a1_p1: 我们提供极具弹性的两级起订量方案：
zh.faq_a1_li1: 现货标准光瓶：1,000 - 3,000 只（非常适合新品试水与配方测试）。
zh.faq_a1_li2: 定制色漆喷涂与丝网印花：每款设计 3,000 - 5,000 只起订。
zh.faq_a1_li3: 专属私模开模定制：30,000 只起，模具开发仅需 15-20 天。
zh.faq_q2: 免费样品盒申请流程是怎样的？
zh.faq_a2: 所有常规玻璃瓶与盖泵配件样品 100% 免费提供！您仅需支付 DHL/FedEx 国际快递费（约 25-35 美元，广州寄出 3-5 天直达欧美）。首笔大货订单中，此快递费将 100% 全额现金抵扣返还！
zh.faq_q3: 你们能提供运往欧美各国的 DDP（包税到门）服务吗？
zh.faq_a3: 完全可以！我们超过 80% 的欧美客户都选择 DDP 门到门包税服务。我们全权负责中国报关出口、国际海空运、目的港双清缴税及尾程卡车派送，直接送至您的仓库或亚马逊 FBA 仓，您无需应对复杂清关手续。
zh.faq_q4: 如何保障瓶器与配方的相容性及绝不渗漏？
zh.faq_a4: 我们的瓶体均采用药用 III 级高白料钠钙玻璃或茶色玻璃精制，化学性质极度稳定且完全无铅，符合欧盟 EU 1223/2009 与美国加州 65 标准。每批配套瓶盖与泵头在出厂前均经过 30 分钟 -0.08 MPa 负压真空气密抽检，确保滴水不漏。
zh.faq_q5: 你们的大货生产与交货周期一般需要多久？
zh.faq_a5_1: • 常规现货光瓶：最快 48–72 小时内极速发出。
zh.faq_a5_2: • 定制喷色与丝印烫金工艺：15–20 个工作日。
zh.faq_a5_3: • 全新私模开模与工程打样：20–25 天提供产前实物样瓶。

zh.about_hero_badge: 品牌故事与源头实体实力
zh.about_hero_title: 您在中国的化妆品包材全案供应链方案商与品质把关人
zh.about_hero_desc: 总部位于全球美妆产业核心腹地——广州。我们架起了中国强大的源头玻璃制造产能与国际高奢美妆品牌严苛品控标准之间的桥梁。
zh.about_dilemma_title: 为什么传统单线窑炉厂无法满足新锐美妆品牌
zh.about_dilemma_p1: 在传统分段制造中，玻璃窑炉厂只压制光瓶，不生产泵头滴管，也不做竹木盖和外盒礼盒。当海外买家自行对接4家不同中国工厂时，只要0.2mm的牙口公差误差，就会导致渗漏、昂贵料体报废及致命的交期延误。
zh.about_dilemma_p2: 广州晶泰包装制品厂采用全新的交钥匙模式。我们作为您的专属全案包装工程团队，统筹管理全链路：高白料玻璃瓶、精准匹配泵盖、表面深加工、高定外盒及出厂前独立的负压跌落实验室质检。
zh.about_gz_title: 广州产业带优势：敏捷度、极速响应与全品类整合
zh.about_gz_desc: 广州白云区拥有超过4000家美妆与包装配套企业。深耕这一世界级产业集群核心，为我们客户带来了无可比拟的供应链效率优势。
zh.about_adv1_desc: 传统内陆窑炉厂需要数周才能寄出样品，而我们背靠广州庞大的现货配件库，白云国际机场直飞，48小时内通过 DHL 发出实物样品。
zh.about_adv2_title: 毗邻枢纽深水港与 DDP 门到门物流
zh.about_adv2_desc: 毗邻广州南沙港与深圳盐田港，直达美国长滩、奥克兰及欧洲鹿特丹直航快线，海运时效整体缩短 7-10 天。
zh.about_adv3_title: 全球顶尖表面深加工集群
zh.about_adv3_desc: 全球密度最高的喷涂、丝印、电镀加工生产线集聚于此，无论是最新工艺趋势还是潘通对色打样，均可极速交付。
zh.about_qa_desc: 每一批大货都由广州专属 QC 质检团队使用高精度卡尺与负压试漏仪逐项验证。
zh.about_qa1_desc: 严查瓶壁厚度均匀度、内部气泡杂质及瓶底平整度。
zh.about_qa2_title: 2. 螺牙口径通止规精密校验
zh.about_qa2_desc: 使用通止规对每一批次螺牙进行公差校验，确保旋合顺滑无卡扣偏差。
zh.about_qa3_title: 3. -0.08 MPa 真空负压防漏测试
zh.about_qa3_desc: 瓶器灌装浸入真空腔体，在 -0.08 MPa 负压下持续保压 30 分钟无气泡溢出。
zh.about_qa4_title: 4. 3M 百格图文附着力耐磨测试
zh.about_qa4_desc: 丝印与烫金文字使用 3M 高强胶带进行百格剥离试验，确保反复擦拭永不掉色。
zh.about_qa5_title: 5. ISTA 3A 国际跌落与抗震测试
zh.about_qa5_desc: 将整箱加固包装从 1.2 米高度多角度跌落水泥地面，检验出口防震防护能力。
zh.footer_description: 立足广州美妆核心产业带的化妆品玻璃包材全案供应链伙伴。主营高端精油滴管瓶、乳液精华泵瓶、重底面霜膏霜瓶及定制表面深加工，支持低起订量与全球 DDP 门到门交付。
